verdict.rationale: Sketch exposes a vanilla JavaScript plugin API, a CLI (sketchtool), URL-scheme integration, and a local MCP server for AI clients, giving programmatic access to many document operations, but there is no evidence of a comprehensive REST/OpenAPI surface covering all UI actions (probe for openapi.json/swagger.json returned 404s), and no documentation claims full UI/API parity. Missing for 10: a documented public API/OpenAPI spec proving full parity with UI features, and confirmation that non-plugin operations (e.g., prototyping, sharing, versioning) are scriptable via API.
